candidate_program.name: strongest_rival_margin
candidate_program.rationale: Ranks a strongest-rival exchange margin with a discounted average of additional blocker mass. Reach is the immediate weighted neighborhood; constant arithmetic adds no graph traversal, but blocker compatibility remains unknown.
candidate_program.rule: weight - max_conflict_weight - 0.25 * max(0, conflict_weight - max_conflict_weight) / (1 + degree)

comparison: exact rational comparison of returned binary float scores
cost_scope: Cached offline score-fit evaluation only; does not replace complete-schedule charged cost
